title: Foo Bar Taxi Semantic Layer APIs
description: Design an analytics schema from pre-seeded raw NYC taxi trip data, define a semantic metrics layer with key business metrics, and expose them via HTTP API endpoints.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must inspect raw NYC taxi trip data in ClickHouse staging tables, design a proper analytics schema, transform and load the data, define semantic business metrics, and expose them through HTTP API endpoints.

tasks.description: Inspect raw staging tables, design an analytics schema with proper transformations, define business metrics (avg_fare, total_revenue, trips_per_day, avg_distance), and expose them as HTTP API endpoints.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse with raw January 2024 NYC taxi trip data pre-seeded into raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01.
